notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
Patch 1.2 is now out.
[list]
[*]Added  New fancy graphic mode "Glow"!
[*]Added "Folder Up" button for the File Manager
[*]Added .wav file support
[*]Added "Back" Option in the Controller Selection
[*]Added Options Menu for changing sound volume
[/list]
[list]
[*]Bosses now drops hearts (to get life back)
[*]File Manager saves last Folder position
[*]Fixing volume for menu sounds
[*]Fixing color bug after Power Mode
[/list]
